text:
Jordan (Finance): following the postmortem, we agreed on a 'sweep' approach before mass invoice corrections: 1) small audit sample to validate root cause, 2) targeted corrections for high-impact accounts, 3) full sweep if audit confirms. owners & ETAs?

Tess (Eng): i'll own the audit dataset and reproducible check. hypothesis = delayed batch replay causing duplicate token attributions during backfill windows. will produce a 200-row sample CSV and a short repro script by 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC. sample query below.

```
SELECT request_id, customer_id, reported_tokens, dedup_candidate
FROM ingest_audit
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-20' AND '2026-03-21'
AND dedup_candidate = true
LIMIT 200;
```

Tess (Eng): i'll upload sample to s3://billing-audit/sweeps/2345678901/sample.csv and tag it private.

BillingBot: file_upload: s3://billing-audit/sweeps/2345678901/sample.csv by @tess-eng at 2026-03-24T15:02:10Z; rows=200; size=32KB

Marco (Billing): once i have the sample i'll map to invoices and run a manual reconciliation for those rows. i'll also prepare a policy doc for corrections: line-item adjustments for invoices > $750, account credit otherwise. target to finish sample reconciliation by 2026-03-25 noon PST.

Ivy (Support): Support will draft two short messages: (A) proactive notice for affected enterprise customers and (B) FAQ for portal. will have drafts by 2026-03-25 10:00 PST.

Jordan (Finance): decision on sweep gating: if sample error rate (tokens overcounted) > 0.8% of sampled token volume, proceed to full sweep; otherwise do only targeted corrections. Tess please publish the sample audit results here.

Tess (Eng): audit run complete: sample shows 1.4% token overcount by volume and concentrated on 6 customers. uploading full impacted list now. will follow with a CI regression that replays delayed batches weekly to prevent recurrence.

BillingBot: file_upload: s3://billing-audit/sweeps/2345678901/impacted_full.csv by @tess-eng at 2026-03-24T18:20:02Z; rows=512; size=102KB

Marco (Billing): mapping done: ~512 requests map to 94 invoices, 28 invoices > $750. estimated adjustment total ~$21,100. plan: run a controlled first correction batch on 2026-03-26 09:00 PST, then expand if all good.

Ivy (Support): templates uploaded: https://drive.redwood/incident-2345678901/templates. will begin outbound for enterprise customers after first batch completes.

Jordan (Finance): action tracker summary:
- Tess (Eng): sample + repro, weekly replay test, PD alert if token-delta > 0.5% (due 2026-03-24 done)
- Marco (Billing): sample reconciliation complete, corrections batch 1 on 2026-03-26 09:00 PST
- Ivy (Support): comms templates & enterprise outreach (ready 2026-03-25 10:00 PST)

Tess (Eng): note - will add a short-term ingest dedupe (10s window) to reduce immediate risk and a long-term fix in the pipeline.

Marco (Billing): proceeding with batch 1; will post completion and reconciliation CSV here.

Jordan (Finance): thanks everyone. i logged the gating rule and timeline in the remediation tracker. update thread when batches finish or if customers escalate. :white_check_mark:
